summary: The United States has dramatically escalated military operations against Iran, attacking oil tankers near Jask, 100 targets across Iran, and residential areas in Sirik, while Trump declared the Strait of Hormuz under US control. Iran retaliated with attacks on Kuwait and shipping in the Strait of Hormuz, killing two people. Regional tensions are intensifying as the US-Iran conflict expands across the Gulf.
key_points: The US attacked two Iranian oil tankers, Hak and Sinopa, near Jask under its new 'oil tanker vs oil tanker' policy, while also striking 100 targets inside Iran and imposing a maritime blockade that reduced Iranian oil exports to their lowest level (Source: @mamlekate/104294).

US strikes on Kouhestak village in Sirik killed at least 4 people including 4-year-old Amirali Karimi and wounded 68, hitting a residential wedding hall and telecom tower approximately 112 meters apart over five separate attacks (Source: @VahidOnline/78197).

A security incident in the Strait of Hormuz involved an attacked oil tanker with two people killed on scene, according to UKMTO, as Iran updated its non-compliant vessel list for the waterway (Source: @yediotnews25/134597; @presstv/205318).

Iranian forces fired at Kuwait, and US bases in Kuwait were attacked, causing oil prices to begin rising; Trump responded by declaring the Strait of Hormuz under US control and suggesting renaming it (Source: @lelotsenzura/94297; @rasedal3ado138e/388483; @naya_foriraq/89237).

IRGC Fajr-e Fars forces from the Khatam al-Anbiya headquarters and Basij of the Fasa district were killed in the US attack on Jahrud on Tuesday night, while PMF ambulances continued transporting wounded to Toum Koubri hospital in Kirkuk, Iraq (Source: @kianmeli1/91466; @naya_foriraq/89267).

The IDF conducted artillery fire toward buildings near Kuwait Junction in the Zaytoun neighborhood of southeast Gaza City, and demolished over 26 kilometers of tunnels on the Israeli side of the Gaza ceasefire line since the October 2025 ceasefire (Source: @yediotnews25/134604; @manniefabian/59085).

Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated the US will continue targeting Iran over shipping attacks, while Trump demanded Iranians 'rise up' against their government and refused to confirm whether the CIA would be sent to arm them (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6780; @mamlekate/104298).

The UAE President Mohamed bin Zayed spoke with Trump by phone about Middle East developments and bilateral cooperation, as the political-security cabinet in Israel convened ahead of anticipated escalation (Source: @N12chat/224751; @yediotnews25/134600).

iran: The US attacked two oil tankers named Hak and Sinopa near Jask under its new 'oil tanker vs oil tanker' policy, and struck 100 targets inside Iran, while a maritime blockade reduced Iranian oil exports to their lowest level, according to Reuters (Source: @mamlekate/104294).

US strikes hit Kouhestak village in Sirik at least five times, targeting a residential wedding hall and a telecom tower approximately 112 meters apart; 4 people were killed including 4-year-old Amirali Karimi and 68 were wounded (Source: @VahidOnline/78197).
IRGC Fajr-e Fars forces from the Khatam al-Anbiya headquarters and Basij of the Fasa district were confirmed killed in the US attack on Jahrud on Tuesday night (Source: @kianmeli1/91466).

Iran's Strait of Hormuz authority updated its list of non-compliant vessels violating Islamic Republic protocols governing the waterway, signaling tightened maritime enforcement amid the conflict (Source: @presstv/205318).

Trump publicly demanded that the people of Iran 'rise up and fight,' stating the Iranian government is 'weaker day by day,' while refusing to confirm whether the CIA would be sent to arm Iranians (Source: @mamlekate/104294; @mamlekate/104298).

The US Treasury Secretary stated that the Islamic Republic has entered an 'acceleration phase of economic collapse,' while the dollar rate in Iran rose from 166,000 tomans on the day Khamenei was killed to 222,000 tomans (Source: @mamlekate/104294; @kianmeli1/91460).
Asian markets fell and oil prices surged past $95 following the escalation, as Iran's oil exports were severely impacted by the US maritime blockade (Source: @mamlekate/104294).

The Israeli political-security cabinet is scheduled to convene Sunday evening amid the escalating regional conflict (Source: @yediotnews25/134600).
An Israeli official stated that Israel does not consider Turkey an enemy but a rival following Turkey's steps in recent years (Source: @naya_foriraq/89239).

sections.threat_assessment: The US-Iran conflict is rapidly expanding beyond bilateral strikes into a broader regional confrontation involving Gulf states, Iraq, and Lebanon. Iran's attacks on Kuwait and shipping in the Strait of Hormuz, combined with US strikes on Iranian residential areas and oil infrastructure, indicate a cycle of escalation with no clear off-ramp. The Strait of Hormuz remains a critical chokepoint where further attacks on commercial shipping could trigger wider international involvement.
sections.regional_response: The UAE President Mohamed bin Zayed engaged Trump by phone to discuss Middle East developments and cooperation, signaling Gulf states' efforts to manage the escalation diplomatically. Israel has not publicly aligned with the US-Iran conflict but is preparing its political-security cabinet for regional developments. Turkey was described by an Israeli official as a 'rival' rather than enemy, reflecting shifting alliances. Iraq's PMF continues operations despite casualties, with wounded being treated in Kirkuk.
sections.intelligence_notes: US policy appears to be simultaneously pressuring Iran economically through maritime blockade and military strikes while publicly encouraging internal uprising, though Trump refused to confirm CIA involvement in arming opposition. Iran's economic indicators show severe stress with the dollar rate rising from 166,000 to 222,000 tomans. The IDF's tunnel demolition campaign and restricted access to southern firing zones suggest continued high-readiness operations in Gaza. Multiple artillery exchanges along the Lebanon border indicate active hostilities there as well.
